scope: Selected vertex-caption contract for /graph and /canvas/graph; documentation and isolated application/type probes only

decisions.data: One optional secondary string per node, separate from stable ID/primary label/role/result; full immutable caption table belongs to snapshot
decisions.api: GraphTraceOptions.nodeCaptions initial table; GraphMarkUpdate.nodeCaptions patches; GraphSnapshot.nodeCaptions optional; GraphNodeView.caption optional; existing mark event gains optional caption patches; GraphRendererOptions.nodeCaptions auto/hidden
decisions.validation: Atomic with node/edge roles; own-data/dense-array capture; node membership and unique patch IDs; copied/frozen canonical snapshot; null clears, empty string stored, undefined text invalid
decisions.completion: done and setLayout preserve captions; Restart returns initial recording/trace captions
decisions.rewind: Read previous/current immutable state, never event or live algorithm Map; no caption-patch replay
decisions.placement: Existing graph fit unchanged; 8 bounded candidates, graph order tie-break; collision-free reservation boxes inside viewport with node/edge/arrow/label/caption safety gaps; suppress when no valid position or full text does not fit
decisions.guaranteeLimit: Does not make existing graph planar or guarantee all captions visible; real font/curve/raster checks remain implementation acceptance
decisions.compatibility: Optional shapes and unchanged closed event cases; existing local extra-property uses of newly recognized names need review; graph entries not published; no Player/core extension
